starting_point: original pretrained LFM2.5; fresh plugin; zero-effect fresh LoRA frozen throughout plugin-only stage
objective: unchanged full-suffix CE; separately report answer and ending CE; stopping and selection use answer CE
selection: nested balanced sets by seed/ID hash from the unchanged 240k official train pool; disjoint fixed 64 official-validation questions; select lowest held-out answer CE among trained plugin states
scope: capacity/optimization audit, not benchmark accuracy; expand nested size only after 100% train answer accuracy and answer CE <= 0.1; no claims of capacity limit or convergence from budget exhaustion
training_policy: main stage plugin-only up to 40 minutes; then fresh AdamW at 1e-5 jointly updates plugin and LoRA for at most 10 minutes and one quarter as many updates; original VLM stays frozen throughout
stop_policy: check every 20 updates; after >=80 plugin updates, stop if both train and validation answer CE fail to improve by max(0.01,1%) across 4 checks, or validation CE stays >10% worse than earlier best for 4 checks while train CE improves; these are diagnostic thresholds, not proof of convergence
